target: Authoritative PRDOH September-2025 463-member public-water-system inventory and subsequent membership-change history sufficient to reconcile EPA SDWIS.

completed_attempts.evidence: 463 total; 160 PRASA; 303 Non-PRASA; page states PRDOH maintains an inventory of all public water systems.
As of September 2025: 463 systems; Table 1 PRASA total 160; Table 2 Non-PRASA 303 = 241 CWS + 54 NTNCWS + 8 TNCWS.
Violation/system subsets only; does not enumerate all 463 systems.
464 active systems in 2026Q3; current member omits 2025Q3.

requested_manifestations.description: Machine-readable inventory of all public water systems regulated by PRDOH as of 2025-09-30, expected denominator 463.
Machine-readable inventory current as of 2026-10-08 or the date supporting the current 463-system PWSS webpage.
Membership/status change log from 2025-09-01 through 2026-10-08, including activations, deactivations, mergers, splits, ownership/operator reclassifications, and PWSID changes.

required_fields: PWSID or PRDOH stable system identifier
successor/predecessor PWSID for merge/split/revision where applicable
acceptance_tests: Stable identifiers are unique within the source manifestation.
Every status change between September 2025 and October 2026 has an effective date and predecessor/successor relationship when applicable.
No identity is inferred from name, count, prefix, phone, geography, or owner code alone.
